Recorded claim:
D320863 added `cal.itip.adaptScheduleAgent()` but omitted `calendar-invitations-manager.js::processJobQueue()`, which directly modifies an invitation then calls `cal.itip.checkAndSend()`. Adapt immediately before `modifyItem()`, and regress an existing CalDAV invitation through the Calendar Invitations dialog with `forceEmailScheduling=true`, asserting `SCHEDULE-AGENT=CLIENT` and one outgoing reply. [Task 13]
